50518247.protein: 5'-AMP-activated protein kinase catalytic subunit alpha-1/subunit beta-1/subunit gamma-1
50518247.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to recombinant human AMPK alpha1/beta1/gamma1 by SPR binding assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: To confirm a direct interaction of compounds with target AMPK isoforms, an in vitro surface plasmon resonance (SPR) binding assay was developed. Biotinylated human recombinant AMPK was captured onto a streptavidin sensor chip, and analytes were injected over the surface. Correlation of binding affinities (Kd) and kinetic parameters (kon, koff) where measurable, with the functional response observed in biochemical assays, provided additional confidence in the observed SAR.
original_paragraph.SPR Analysis: The SPR binding assay was performed using a Biacore T200 instrument (GE Healthcare). Biotinylated human recombinant AMPK α1β1γ1 (100 nM) was captured onto a streptavidin sensor chip (GE Healthcare) at 25 °C. The chip was blocked with 100 mM ethanolamine, pH 8.5, for 10 min. Analytes were injected at concentrations ranging from 0.1 to 1000 nM in HBS-EP buffer (10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA, 0.005% P20) at a flow rate of 30 μL/min for 120 s, followed by a 300 s dissociation phase. Regeneration was achieved with 10 mM glycine, pH 2.0, for 30 s. Data were analyzed using Biacore T200 evaluation software (GE Healthcare). Binding affinities (Kd) were determined by fitting the sensorgrams to a 1:1 Langmuir binding model. Kinetic parameters (kon, koff) were calculated from the fitted curves. The Kd values reported are the geometric mean of at least three replicates ± standard error of the mean (SEM).

analyte.description: Compounds being tested for binding to AMPK

assay_conditions.running_buffer_composition: HBS-EP buffer (10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA, 0.005% P20)
